cloudDescription.text: The cloud connection provides live and historical SAX Power data independently of the optional Modbus integration.

apiUrl.label: SAX Power API URL
apiUrl.help: Base URL of the SAX Power dashboard API.

username.label: Email address
username.help: Email address used for the SAX Power dashboard.

password.label: Password
password.help: Password used for the SAX Power dashboard.

pollInterval.label: Polling interval
pollInterval.help: Interval for retrieving live data from SAX Power.

modbusDescription.text: Modbus control is optional. The adapter continues to provide all SAX Power cloud data while this feature is disabled.

modbusControlEnabled.label: Enable Modbus control
modbusControlEnabled.help: Enable forwarding of SAX Power control commands to selected writable Modbus states.

modbusInstance.label: Modbus instance
modbusInstance.help: Select the Modbus adapter instance containing the SAX Power registers.

modbusChargePowerStateId.label: Charge power state
modbusChargePowerStateId.help: Select the writable numeric Modbus state for SAX register 44, charging power limit.

modbusDischargePowerStateId.label: Discharge power state
modbusDischargePowerStateId.help: Optional writable numeric Modbus state for SAX register 43, discharging power limit.

modbusNote.text: Register 44 is used for the charging power limit. Register 43 is intended for the discharging power limit and may not yet exist in every Modbus adapter configuration.

supportDescription.text: If this adapter is useful to you, you can support its continued development with a voluntary PayPal contribution.

supportPrivacy.text: The PayPal page opens only after clicking the button. The adapter itself does not transmit payment or account data.
